{
  "name": "cpm-next-progress",
  "version": "0.7.2",
  "description": "Keeps a claude.ai progress tracker for each cpm-next spec in step with its epic docs, in the build order you set, and shows every project's trackers at a glance in a pane and on an overview page, and times each story so it can say how long the next one should take; it tells Claude which rows to write and never writes to a page itself.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Chris Aves"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "cpm-next",
    "epics",
    "progress",
    "tracker",
    "artifact",
    "mod"
  ]
}
